top_signals.title: Jackson Warns US Policy Risks Caribbean Stability
top_signals.summary: Rep. Jonathan Jackson says the Trump administration's policies toward Haiti, Venezuela and Cuba risk worsening instability across the Caribbean, arguing that ending Temporary Protected Status for Haitians and maintaining broad sanctions will deepen humanitarian and migration challenges. He also calls for greater transparency in US policy toward Venezuela and warns that continued pressure on Cuba could further destabilize the region. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump Media says $165 million bitcoin transfer to Crypto.com wasn’t a sale
top_signals.summary: The company said a similar transfer to Crypto.com in May was part of a broader trading strategy and did not represent a sale.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary: The focus is on the decision of the prime minister, who prioritizes the regular budget and calls for an end to the government's reliance on supplementary budgets.
